newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cathay Pacific buys three more Airbus jets.
newsitem.headline: Cathay Pacific buys three more Airbus jets.

text.p: Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd has signed a contract to buy two more long-range Airbus A340-300 and one A330-300 passenger aircraft, Airbus Industrie said on Monday.
Including the latest contract, Cathay has placed firm orders for a total 24 planes in the Airbus A330/340 family, comprising 11 A340-300s and 13 A330-300s, Airbus said.

Airbus is a consortium made up of French state-owned Ste Nationale Industrielle Aerospatiale British Aerospace Plc, Daimler-Benz Aerospace, a unit of Daimler-Benz AG and Construcciones Aeronauticas SA (CASA) of Spain.
Average list price for the A340-300 and A340-300 is around $125 million, industry sources said.

The latest aircraft will be delivered in the fourth quarter of 1998, Airbus said. The A340 will seat 261 passengers in three classes and the A330 will accommodate 320 in two classes. All seats in all classes will have personal television systems.
